name: Drink
description: Drink something from the NPC's own inventory (including anything the player just gave them), such as ale, mead or wine. Only if the NPC actually wants to; they can turn it down in character instead.
note: Living World (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). Recorded as a consume perception event, so witnesses remember it and it counts towards being tipsy.

drink.description: What to drink, as one word from the item's name (for example 'mead', 'ale', 'wine', 'water'). Leave empty for any drink they have.

prompt: If you are offered a drink or asked to drink, and you want to, begin your response with '{key}:'
